title: Turkish Kazandibi with Rice
description: A traditional Turkish dessert made with a creamy rice pudding and topped with a caramelized sugar crust.
instructions: Combine rice, oily, and salt in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 18 minutes.
Stir in sugars and Turkish Kazandibi. Cook for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice. Let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, sprinkle with additional sugars if desired.
